title: A New Assassin
text: And so… a few days later, indeed.
“Naofumi!”
Ren, having fled, came to the village in his inult form, I say.
“Huh? Um, what’s wrong, Kelsus-kun?”
“Don’t ‘what’s wrong’ me! What in the world is that thing!”
“That thing?”
Ren was yapping away.
“The one that goes ‘Ruf’ or whatever!”
“Isn’t that more Rafumi-chan’s group than mine?”
Father furrowed his brow and scolded him.
“That’s true, but make it stop!”
“That’s just taking it out on me… don’t blame me just because it’s easy to.”
“How could I not say something!”
Right about then, Ren noticed me and lunged, so I knocked him back, indeed.
“You’re involved in this too!”
“I didn’t make it because I wanted to. I was threatened, I say.”
Ren landed and swung his sword wildly in protest, so I dodged it.
“Even if you were threatened, don’t make something like that!”
“So anyway, what happened? Did Ruf-kun do something, like Rafumi-chan did?”

“Might as well have! That thing suddenly showed up, cutely nuzzled up to Luna, and started helping Keel wait on customers during my dark cooking contest! And it keeps stealing bites of food on top of that!”
“Um, setting the food-stealing aside, so it’s just helping Keel-kun and Luna-chan wait tables while you cook, Kelsus?”
Was there really a problem with that, I wondered?
“What do you mean ‘just’! It butted into my peaceful dark cooking contest, and on top of that it’s stealing Luna’s attention!”
“Weren’t you the one avoiding Luna-chan? Why does it matter now?”
“That thing goes out holding hands with Keel! And Keel’s over there saying, ‘A cool kid who looks kinda like me! It’s a bit like Wolf-niichan too, but I’m gonna copy it and become a man!’”
“Ahh… maybe Luna-chan thinks Ruf-kun has better chances than you do, Kelsus. Maybe you need to show you’re getting along with Keel-kun a bit more?”
“Guh…”

Keel really could get along with just about anyone, after all. If anything, she was the type to drag socially awkward Ren along, indeed. And now this Ruf had joined in, making it a proper love triangle, I say.
“‘Am I going to lose my place to something like that again!’ I thought, and when I stepped forward, ‘Raph, Raph, how about that one as an assassin?’ it said, and showed itself.”

Somehow I could picture it — Ruf and Keel getting along happily while Luna-chan watched on with delight, and Ren staring at the scene with the exact same face he’d made when Rafumi stole his companions before.
“Vof… the damage is spreading.”
“Wolf! What is that thing! Is it your kid!?”
“Voff! No! I want kids someday, but that’s not mine!”
Wolf transformed into wolf form and flopped down in front of Father, rolling onto his back to ask for belly rubs. How dare he, indeed. He’s really made a habit out of this!
“Seems like Wolf’s pretty curious about that kid too, huh.”
“Is that so? What a coincidence. Well then, you take it in.”
“No way! You go ahead and travel together and make it a love triangle over there! I’ve got plenty of rivals of my own to deal with over here!”
“You’re refusing here of all times?”
Ren pointed his sword with a clank and yapped away, indeed.
“Well, Wolf gets along with Shion and the others, doesn’t he. Seems like he’s enjoying the competition to minimize Wave damage.”
Though since he’s a Hero, Wolf’s got quite the advantage, Father added — clearly under some kind of misunderstanding, I say.
“Raph, Raph, glad you like it so much.”
“Shut up!”
The moment Rafumi appeared, Ren attacked, only to have it dodged with a puff.
“Fufu, since the first one’s already done, mass production shouldn’t be too difficult. I suppose I should think about telling Luna that too, hm?”
Even Father from a different loop had asked about increasing the Raph-species population before, I recalled.
“Guh… what’s your goal!”

“There are many things, Azott. Surely you already know full well what I want from you? It’s about time you handled some Melromarc official duties in between playing around with your dark cooking, don’t you think?”
“Guhhhh…”
“Waaa… how cruel… well, I do sometimes work alongside Wolf over in Siltvelt too.”
“Ah yes, even Shield Hero does that, you know? I’d appreciate it if you’d stop leaving it all to just me, hm? Ah?”
“Damn iiiiit!”
Ren bared his fangs and growled.

“So this is Rafumi-chan’s way of persuading Ren, huh — looks like it’ll end with Luna-chan all smiles down the line… I wonder if Ruf-kun’s going to end up marrying into Keel-kun’s family? Is Keel-kun just really popular?”

Who could say? I couldn’t care less what became of Keel, so I don’t remember, indeed. But that thing was made from a mix of Wolf’s, Keel’s, and Ren’s fur, wasn’t it? If anything, wouldn’t that make it closer to their child? Well, all sorts of things got mixed together, so I suppose it’s fine.
“Still, since Ruf-kun loves fighting, it seems like it could get along with Ren — I mean, Kelsus — pretty well.”
“Yeah, that thing’s oddly eager to fight, always going ‘let’s battle’ at me.”
“Vof… seriously, what on earth did you make?”
“Fufu… go ahead and hate it all you like. Just like my original.”
Was that referring to Big Sister, I wondered? Though in later years, their relationship turned out reasonably well, indeed.
“Now then, you understand what to do, don’t you? Azott?”
“Guh… Naofumi, what am I supposed to do?”
“It’s not that hard… just put on a friendly smile, wave your hand, and let the people around you handle the difficult parts. Just act normal in public and say harmless things.”

“In Melromarc’s case, the Queen and Melty-chan will support you,” Father explained to Ren. Well, back when he couldn’t manage on his own, Father used to just dump all the troublesome official duties on Fiancée and get an earful for it. In this loop, though, it was mostly Wolf handling Siltvelt’s official duties up front, indeed.
“Fufu, what you have to do doesn’t change all that much, basically speaking.”
“…Well, from the little I’ve seen, I guess you just need to practice some chuunibyou lines, or maybe keep Kuro-chan’s way of talking in mind.”
“I seriously don’t want to do this…”
Ren, still in his inult form, hugged his own arms as if he’d broken out in goosebumps, shaking his head.

“Still, if you keep hating it, seems like Ruf-kun’s just going to keep mooching food off you, Ren. It comes around my place too, you know. I wonder if all the kids with that look take after Keel-kun?”
It came around Father’s place too, after all. That thing sure got around a lot, I say.
“Damn it… does it bother Itsuki too?”
“I don’t think it’s got the personality to connect with Itsuki. Haven’t really seen it around him, but it’s more in the beast category, I’d say…”
Probably closer to a mascot, right? Father looked like he wanted to say “kind of like Wolf back in the day,” but held it back.
“Ruffuu.”
While we were talking about all this, the very creature named Ruf showed itself, indeed.
“Honestly, Gaelion didn’t expect that spirit to show up here, nano.”
Had Rival brought it along, I wondered?
“Ruffuuu!”
Then it pointed at Wolf, striking a pose like it was challenging him to a match. And in its hand… was a weapon that stirred a memory from somewhere far off, indeed.
“Huh? Um, that weapon. Doesn’t it look kind of like the ones Wolf and Rafumi-chan use?”
“V-Vof? No way, is that a Gauntlet?”
Oh! Indeed it was! The Gauntlet, one of the Seven Star Weapons, which in this loop I’d never once seen held by anyone but Tiger Guy, was now resting in this Ruf’s hand, I say.
“Just so. Well, there was a possibility, so while bringing it along I let it have a light greeting and touch the weapon, and it seems to have taken quite a liking to it.”
“Rufufu! Ruff!”
Ruf waved Wolf over as if to say, “C’mon! Let’s have a match!”
“Vof…”

Rival grumbled under its breath, “Well aren’t you lucky, choosing a fragment of soul with just enough qualification to have once been Chosen, nano,” turning its face away. Though it seemed no one but me could hear it, indeed.
“So you’ve gone and become Gauntlet Hero too, nano?”
“Ruff!”
“Alright, let’s throw doooown!” Ruf cried, raising its fist and lunging at Wolf, indeed.
